say.hi: Customer ने आज का gold rate पूछने के लिए call किया, और फिर नहीं आया।
say.en: A customer *called* to ask today's *gold rate*, and *never came in*.

show.hi: Customer ne aaj ka *gold rate* poochne ke liye *call* kiya, aur phir *nahi aaya*.

say.hi: पहली problem: हर दिन वही सवाल, आज का rate क्या है?
say.en: Problem one: the *same question* every day. What's today's *rate*?

show.hi: Pehli problem: har din *wahi sawaal*, aaj ka *rate* kya hai?

say.hi: Fix: website पर आज का rate, जो आप सुबह एक बार update करते हो।
say.en: The fix: *today's rate* on your website, which you update *once* each morning.

show.hi: Fix: website par *aaj ka rate*, jo aap subah *ek baar* update karte ho.

say.hi: दूसरी problem: customer designs देखने के लिए दुकान तक आना पड़ता है।
say.en: Problem two: customers have to *come to the shop* just to see *designs*.

show.hi: Doosri problem: customer *designs* dekhne ke liye *dukaan tak* aana padta hai.

say.hi: Fix: online catalogue, weight, purity और making charges के साथ, और visit book करने का button।
say.en: The fix: an online *catalogue* with *weight*, *purity* and making charges, and a *button* to book a visit.

show.hi: Fix: online *catalogue*, *weight*, *purity* aur making charges ke saath, aur visit book karne ka *button*.

say.hi: तीसरी problem: नया customer भरोसा कैसे करे?
say.en: Problem three: why should a new customer *trust* you?

show.hi: Teesri problem: naya customer *bharosa* kaise kare?

say.hi: Fix: hallmark details, reviews, photos और address, सब एक page पर।
say.en: The fix: *hallmark* details, *reviews*, photos and your *address*, all on one page.

show.hi: Fix: *hallmark* details, *reviews*, photos aur *address*, sab ek page par.

say.hi: Rate, catalogue, भरोसा, तीनों आपकी website पर।
